v1.title: First attempts
v1.note: Three different hands tried the same picture: one in the classic MS Paint way, one in oil, one in watercolour.

v2.title: Painting from a written plan
v2.note: The whole painting was planned on paper first, move by move, then painted from that plan.

v3.title: Learning to paint
v3.note: The first painting made stroke by stroke with an oil study as the guide.

v4.title: Agent K learns to paint
v4.note: Agent K paints the photo stroke by stroke in four styles. Big brushes first, fine marks last, always looking at the whole picture.

items.title: Classic MS Paint
items.note: The classic MS Paint way: shapes first, airbrush shading, pencil details.

items.title: Oil
items.note: Big brush masses and bristle strokes that follow the forms.

items.title: Watercolour
items.note: Thin transparent layers built up one over another.

items.title: Fable plan
items.note: Painted from a written plan of every move. The plan was rewritten five times.

items.title: Painter, 1K oil target
items.note: The first stroke-by-stroke painting, guided by an oil study of the photo.

items.title: Oil
items.note: Thick paint, broad strokes, a palette knife on the water.

items.title: Watercolour
items.note: Thin washes over paper, soft edges, light left in the paper.

items.title: Coloured pencil
items.note: Coloured pencil, layered hatching on cream paper.

items.title: Graphite sketch
items.note: Graphite only, black and white on white paper.
